muscles.evidence: Chest, shoulders and upper back use strong purple; core and thighs use pale lilac across the six figures. The highlighted regions remain attached to the same anatomy.

cueAgreement.evidence: The six unchanged authored cues match the reviewed push-up, two rows, squat clean, overhead press, and reset images in order.
